# CloseSync AI

> AI platform for closing clients and running client operations — proposals, contracts, payments, retainers, bookings and insights in one place.

CloseSync AI helps freelancers and agencies generate proposals, send contracts for e-signature, collect payments, run retainers, and automate client onboarding.
